title: Mconet ServiceAccess
description: Language-neutral non-sensitive service access configuration containing an optional HTTP endpoint, ordered header and query occurrences, optional provider context, and namespaced extensions.
$comment: Copyright © 2026 Mcont. Authorization is intentionally forbidden because open authorization objects and credentials require a separate secure configuration protocol and must not enter ordinary JSON serialization.

endpoint.description: Optional absolute HTTP or HTTPS endpoint without user information or a fragment.

headers.description: Ordered non-sensitive header occurrences with repeated names preserved.

query.description: Ordered pre-encoding query occurrences with repeated names preserved.

apiVersion.description: Optional provider API version interpreted by the selected integration.

httpEndpoint.description: Absolute HTTP or HTTPS UriValue accepted at the ordinary configuration boundary.

queryField.description: One case-sensitive query occurrence before percent-encoding.

jsonPrimitive.description: Primitive value represented directly by JSON.

jsonRecord.description: String-keyed JSON object whose values remain recursively JSON-compatible.
